changeSet.author: system

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.table_constraints WHERE constraint_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'cash_drawer_logs' AND constraint_name = 'cash_drawer_logs_event_type_check' AND constraint_type = 'CHECK'

changeSet.comment: Update cash_drawer_logs event_type constraint to include ALL DrawerEventType enum values. This ensures MANUAL_DEPOSIT and MANUAL_WITHDRAWAL are allowed in the database constraint. Also fixes any invalid event_type values from server database dumps.
changeSet.sql: -- Drop the existing constraint ALTER TABLE cash_drawer_logs DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS cash_drawer_logs_event_type_check;

-- Fix any invalid event_type values by setting them to a valid default (SALE_INFLOW) -- This handles cases where server database dumps contain invalid enum values UPDATE cash_drawer_logs SET event_type = 'SALE_INFLOW'::character varying WHERE event_type::text NOT IN ( 'OPENING_BALANCE', 'SALE_INFLOW', 'SALE_REFUND', 'MANUAL_DEPOSIT', 'MANUAL_WITHDRAWAL', 'CLOSING_BALANCE' );

-- Add updated constraint with ALL DrawerEventType enum values included ALTER TABLE cash_drawer_logs ADD CONSTRAINT cash_drawer_logs_event_type_check CHECK (event_type::text = ANY (ARRAY[ 'OPENING_BALANCE'::character varying::text, 'SALE_INFLOW'::character varying::text, 'SALE_REFUND'::character varying::text, 'MANUAL_DEPOSIT'::character varying::text, 'MANUAL_WITHDRAWAL'::character varying::text, 'CLOSING_BALANCE'::character varying::text ]));
